review_conclusions.result: has() and one() both preserve full traversal. one() retains the first AttributeUsage identity, counts all matching usages, and delays singularity failure until after traversal. Neither selection evaluates native arguments or adds shared state.

Definitions/capability policies use canonical ReflectionClass identity; inherited definitions are reduced by specificity. Discovery invalidates on newly available declarations. User composition rules disable plan memoization. No additional shortcut recommended at effectful availability boundaries.

Attributes are instantiated when their handlers execute; native arguments are not stored in shared plans. Existing Make/Proxy ordering ensures Make is selected first even if source declaration order is reversed.

New runtime probes confirm attribute destructors may reveal a following handler; a destructor cannot insert a handler before an already executed prefix. Fresh creation uses the now available composition.
A set hook revealing a new property transformer causes the completed-property guard to reject the old attempt without replaying the setter; fresh creation applies both handlers with one setter call.
Lazy and Proxy attempts rerun failed construction/setup with fresh native argument objects. Successful attempts release temporary arguments once the caller releases its caught exception/trace.
ObjectPipeline create(ReflectionObject) does not retain the reflected source object or its payload in the constructor-plan cache after the caller drops it.
Strict merge behavior rejects null versus zero and distinct equal-valued objects, but preserves a shared object identity when both sources agree.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Componenta\Config\Config;
use Componenta\Config\DependencyDefinitions;
use Componenta\Config\Environment;
use Componenta\DI\Container;
use Componenta\DI\ContainerFactory;
use Componenta\DI\Definition\Definition;
use Componenta\DI\Exception\CircularDependencyException;
use Componenta\DI\Exception\ConcurrentResolutionException;
use Componenta\DI\Exception\ResolutionException;

[$program, $source, $autoload, $selector] = $argv;
(require $selector)($autoload, $source . '/src');

$assertions = 0;
$observations = [];
$check = static function (bool $condition, string $label) use (&$assertions): void {
    ++$assertions;
    if (!$condition) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Probe assertion failed: ' . $label);
    }
};
$build = static function (): Container {
    $wrapper = (new ContainerFactory())->create(new Config([], new Environment([])), new DependencyDefinitions([]));
    if (!$wrapper->container instanceof Container) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Unexpected container type.');
    }
    return $wrapper->container;
};

foreach ([false, true] as $fresh) {
    foreach ([false, true] as $inFiber) {
        $container = $build();
        $ids = ['0', '01', '-1', '1.0'];
        $calls = 0;
        foreach ($ids as $index => $id) {
            $next = $ids[($index + 1) % count($ids)];
            $container->set($id, Definition::factory(static function () use ($container, $fresh, $next, &$calls): mixed {
                if (++$calls > 4) {
                    throw new RuntimeException('Cycle was not stopped at the repeated id.');
                }
                return $fresh ? $container->make($next) : $container->get($next);
            }));
        }
        $read = static fn(): mixed => $fresh ? $container->make('0') : $container->get('0');
        $cycle = null;
        try {
            $inFiber ? new Fiber($read)->start() : $read();
        } catch (CircularDependencyException $exception) {
            $cycle = $exception;
        }
        $check($cycle instanceof CircularDependencyException, 'numeric cycle exception');
        $check($cycle->chain === ['0', '01', '-1', '1.0', '0'], 'numeric cycle chain and key identities');
        $check($calls === 4, 'numeric cycle factory count');
        foreach ($ids as $id) {
            $value = (object) ['id' => $id];
            $container->set($id, Definition::factory(static fn(): object => $value));
            $check(($fresh ? $container->make($id) : $container->get($id)) === $value, 'main recovery after cycle ' . $id);
        }
        $observations[] = ['case' => 'numeric-cycle', 'fresh' => $fresh, 'in_fiber' => $inFiber, 'chain' => $cycle->chain, 'calls' => $calls];
    }
}

foreach (['throw', 'abandon'] as $termination) {
    $container = $build();
    $calls = 0;
    $container->set('0', Definition::factory(static function () use (&$calls): object {
        if (++$calls === 1) {
            Fiber::suspend('source-suspended');
        }
        return new stdClass();
    }));
    $container->alias('01', '0');
    $fiber = new Fiber(static fn(): mixed => $container->get('01'));
    $reference = WeakReference::create($fiber);
    $check($fiber->start() === 'source-suspended', 'source suspension');
    $blocked = null;
    try {
        $container->get('0');
    } catch (ConcurrentResolutionException $exception) {
        $blocked = $exception;
    }
    $check($blocked instanceof ConcurrentResolutionException, 'source remains exclusively owned');
    if ($termination === 'throw') {
        $cause = new RuntimeException('cancel source construction');
        $failure = null;
        try {
            $fiber->throw($cause);
        } catch (ResolutionException $exception) {
            $failure = $exception;
        }
        $check($failure instanceof ResolutionException && $failure->getPrevious() === $cause, 'source cancellation exception boundary');
        $check($fiber->isTerminated(), 'source cancellation termination');
        $recovered = $container->get('0');
        $check($container->get('01') === $recovered, 'recovery while terminated Fiber remains referenced');
    }
    unset($fiber, $failure, $cause, $blocked, $exception);
    gc_collect_cycles();
    $check($reference->get() === null, 'fiber is not retained');
    $entry = $container->get('0');
    $check(is_object($entry), 'source recovery result');
    $check($container->get('01') === $entry, 'source and alias share recovered identity');
    $check($calls === 2, 'source recovery creates exactly once more');
    $observations[] = ['case' => 'shared-source-recovery', 'termination' => $termination, 'calls' => $calls];
}

$container = $build();
$first = new stdClass();
$second = new stdClass();
$container->set('0', $first);
$container->set('01', $second);
$container->set('-1', null);
$container->set('1.0', false);
$check($container->get('0') === $first && $container->get('01') === $second, 'distinct numeric string cache keys');
$check($container->has('-1') && $container->get('-1') === null, 'numeric null cache');
$check($container->has('1.0') && $container->get('1.0') === false, 'numeric false cache');
$container->alias('0', '01');
$container->alias('-1', '1.0');
$check($container->get('0') === $second, 'numeric alias retarget invalidates old result');
$check($container->get('-1') === false, 'numeric alias retarget replaces null result');
$observations[] = ['case' => 'numeric-cache-and-retarget'];

echo json_encode(['php' => PHP_VERSION, 'assertions' => $assertions, 'observations' => $observations], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT), PHP_EOL;

$loads = 0;

        if (!class_exists('RevealedQuery', false)) {

function reentrantDiscovery(#[EarlierLabel('earlier'), ReviewLabel('known'), DiscoveryBridge] string $value): void {}
$target = new ParameterTarget(new ReflectionParameter('reentrantDiscovery', 0));
$events = [];
$nestedValue = null;

        $events[] = 'earlier';
    }
    if ($class === 'DiscoveryBridge') {
        $events[] = 'bridge:start';
        $nestedValue = $target->firstAttribute(ReviewLabel::class)?->value;
        class_alias(ReviewLabel::class, 'EarlierLabel');

    $check('side effect does not require loading the bridge itself', !class_exists('DiscoveryBridge', false));

    spl_autoload_unregister($loader);
}

final class ReviewPauseResolver implements ParameterResolverInterface
{
    public int $calls = 0;

    public function supports(ParameterTarget $target): bool
    {
        return $target->name === 'pause';
    }

    public function resolveParameter(ParameterTarget $target, ParameterResolutionContext $context): ?array
    {
        ++$this->calls;
        $before = $context->resolved;
        if (Fiber::getCurrent() !== null) {
            Fiber::suspend($before);
        }
        if ($context->resolved !== $before) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Another invocation changed suspended parameter state.');
        }
        return [$target->position, $context->resolved[0]];
    }
}

function interleavedParameters(string $label, string $pause, string ...$values): array
{
    return [$label, $pause, $values];
}

$resolver = new ReviewPauseResolver();
$value = (new ContainerFactory())->create(
    new Config([], new Environment([])),
    new DependencyDefinitions(['parameter_resolvers' => [2000 => $resolver]]),
);
$container = $value->container;
if (!$container instanceof Container) {

$check('warm named callable before suspension', $container->call('interleavedParameters', ['label' => 'warm']) === ['warm', 'warm', []]);
$left = new Fiber(static fn(): mixed => $container->call('interleavedParameters', ['label' => 'left', 'values' => ['one', 'named' => 'two']]));
$right = new Fiber(static fn(): mixed => $container->call('interleavedParameters', ['label' => 'right', 'values' => ['three']]));
$check('left suspension has only its own resolved prefix', $left->start() === ['left']);
$check('right suspension has only its own resolved prefix', $right->start() === ['right']);
$right->resume();
$left->resume();
$check('right arguments survive reversed completion order', $right->getReturn() === ['right', 'right', ['three']]);
$check('left variadic order and named key survive suspension', $left->getReturn() === ['left', 'left', ['one', 'named' => 'two']]);
$check('each parameter resolver executes exactly once', $resolver->calls === 3);

function freshDefaultObject(object $value = new stdClass()): object
{
    return $value;
}
$first = $container->call('freshDefaultObject');
$second = $container->call('freshDefaultObject');
$check('warmed named plan does not share native default objects', $first instanceof stdClass && $second instanceof stdClass && $first !== $second);

$payload = new stdClass();
$weak = WeakReference::create($payload);
$closure = static fn(int $value = 1): array => [$payload, $value];
$result = $container->call($closure);
$check('closure capture is present during invocation', $result === [$payload, 1]);
unset($result, $closure, $payload);
$check('parameter metadata does not retain a completed closure capture', $weak->get() === null);

echo json_encode(['php' => PHP_VERSION, 'source' => realpath($source), 'checks' => $checks], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT), PHP_EOL;
